description: For remodel scope, this inspection checklist records demolition, new work, allowances, selections, exclusions, temporary conditions, sequence, and responsibility boundaries. subtitle: Remodel Scope Inspection Checklist: residential or commercial remodel scope definition using existing spaces, demolition, and existing-condition photos.
title: Remodel Scope Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during residential or commercial remodel scope definition when the remodel scope record must identify existing spaces, owner objectives, fixtures, finishes, structural interfaces, utilities, access, and occupied operations. Complete the applicable handoff for agreed scope, assumptions and exclusions, budget handoff, design questions, milestone plan, and owner acknowledgment.
